cues.text:
I bring the weight of yesterday
The doubts I cannot put away

You meet me in this quiet place
And hold me gently in Your grace

I do not have to hide my tears
Or find the words for all my fears

Your promise rests beneath it all
You will not leave me when I fall

Through every sorrow, every change
Your love in Christ remains the same

You hold me close through all I face
And nothing takes me from Your grace

Through days of doubt and nights of fear
You never leave; You meet me here

Whatever comes, Your promise stands
I'm held securely in Your hands

When roads are long and hope feels small
Your love stays with me through it all

You go before; You walk beside
There is no place Your love can't find

The world may change beneath my feet
But I am Yours, and You keep me

Not by the strength that I can bring
But by Your mercy, Christ my King

Through every sorrow, every change
Your love in Christ remains the same

You hold me close through all I face
And nothing takes me from Your grace

Through days of doubt and nights of fear
You never leave; You meet me here

Whatever comes, Your promise stands
I'm held securely in Your hands

Neither life nor death can take
The love You give, the vow You make

Nothing in creation stands
Beyond the keeping of Your hands

Jesus, in Your love I rest
You know the road I have not met
I trust the promise You have made
Your faithful love will never fade

Through every sorrow, every change
Your love in Christ remains the same

You hold me close through all I face
And nothing takes me from Your grace

Through days of doubt and nights of fear
You never leave; You meet me here

Whatever comes, Your promise stands
I'm held securely in Your hands

Nothing between us, held by grace
I rest within Your love today
